mapper.select:
/*selectMasterMdCmCmsPriceValidList*/ SELECT P.CMS_CATLG_ID || '-' || LPAD(P.CATLG_SEQ, 5, '0') AS TCODE /* 행 유니크 키 (hidden) */ ,'' AS BUYER_ITEM_CODE /* 고객사 전용코드 - 백킹 테이블 없음 */ ,P.CMS_CATLG_ID /* 상품정보코드 */ ,(SELECT CATEG_NAME FROM CMSCATEG WHERE CMS_CATEG_ID = C.CMS_CATEG_ID AND STATUS <> 'D') AS CMS_CATEG_ID /* 카테고리(표시는 분류명) */ ,C.DESCRIPTION_LOC /* 품명 */ ,C.SPECIFICATION /* 규격 */ ,C.MAKER_NAME /* 제조사 */ ,(SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M001' AND CODE = C.ORIGIN_CODE) AS ORIGIN_CODE_NAME /* 원산지 */ ,C.ORDER_MEASURE /* 단위 */ ,C.MODEL_INFO /* 모델번호 */ ,DECODE(P.STATUS, 'D', '불가', '가능') AS USE_STATUS /* 상태(공급상태) */ ,P.CMS_CATLG_ID || '-' || LPAD(P.CATLG_SEQ, 5, '0') AS BUY_INFO_ID /* 구매정보코드 (키, 화면 hidden) */ ,LPAD(P.CATLG_SEQ, 5, '0') AS BUY_INFO_SEQ /* 구매정보코드 : 화면 표기는 순번만 쓴다(상품정보코드는 옆 열에 있다) */ ,(SELECT CMPY.COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY CMPY WHERE CMPY.COM_CODE = P.AGENT) AS VENDOR_NAME /* 협력사명 */ ,P.BUY_PRICE AS UNIT_PRICE /* 단가 */ ,P.DELIVERY_LT AS LEADTIME /* 조달일수 */ ,P.MIN_ORDER_QTY AS MOQ /* MOQ */ ,P.PUR_UNIT_QTY AS ORDER_MULTIPLE /* 발주배수 */ ,(SELECT MD.TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 MD WHERE MD.TYPE = 'M034' AND MD.CODE = P.PROCESS_TYPE) AS TRADE_TYPE /* 거래유형 */ ,(SELECT MD.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 MD WHERE MD.TYPE = 'M186' AND MD.CODE = P.DELIVERY_TYPE) AS DELIVERY_COND /* 배송조건(배송유형) */ ,P.BUY_CLOSE_DATE AS PRICE_VALID_DATE /* 매입단가 유효일(종료일) */ ,P.SELLER_ITEM_NO AS VENDOR_ITEM_CODE /* 협력사 상품코드 */ ,(SELECT MD.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 MD WHERE MD.TYPE = 'TX17' AND MD.CODE = P.TAX_TYPE) AS TAX_TYPE /* 세액구분(과세구분) */ ,'' AS TEMP_COND /* 온도조건 - 백킹 컬럼 없음 */ ,'' AS REPLY_STATUS /* 회신상태 - 협력사 회신 미설계 */ ,'' AS REPLY_PRICE /* 회신단가 - 위와 동일 */ ,'' AS REPLY_REMARK /* 회신비고 - 위와 동일 */ FROM CMSPRICE P, CMSCATLG C WHERE P.CMS_CATLG_ID = C.CMS_CATLG_ID
AND UPPER(P.CMS_CATLG_ID) LIKE UPPER(#{st_catlg_id}) || '%'
AND C.CMS_CATEG_ID = #{st_cata_code}
AND C.SPECIFICATION LIKE '%' || #{st_item_keyword} || '%'
AND C.DESCRIPTION_LOC LIKE '%' || #{st_item_keyword} || '%'
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ICOMCMPY CMPY WHERE CMPY.COM_CODE = P.AGENT AND CMPY.COM_NAME_LOC LIKE '%' || #{st_agent_name} || '%')
AND NVL(P.STATUS, 'C') != 'D'
AND P.STATUS = 'D'
AND P.BUY_CLOSE_DATE IS NOT NULL AND P.BUY_CLOSE_DATE >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AND P.BUY_CLOSE_DATE <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE + 30, 'YYYYMMDD')
AND P.BUY_CLOSE_DATE IS NOT NULL AND P.BUY_CLOSE_DATE < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD')
AND P.BUY_CLOSE_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date}
ORDER BY P.CMS_CATLG_ID, P.CATLG_SEQ
